resources.string: Combines small banknotes once a few have piled up and leaves large ones as they are. Free.
Acme Cash is pocket money on Lightning, kept by Acme for you. Keep amounts small.
Acme can\'t restore your money for you. If you haven\'t yet, back up your recovery phrase in Settings: without it, a lost phone means lost money.
Combine small banknotes waits until a few have piled up, so sorting them costs nothing.
